author: reek
body: Persisting the index, proven. Three editions go into the store: a.codex twice (the second supersedes the first) and b.codex once. The whole materialized index is snapshotted as a kind-40 fact, then c.codex is added AFTER the snapshot. A fast rebuild -- load the snapshot, replay only the tail -- must produce the same checkout as a full replay of the whole log; the snapshot on its own must check out the tree as of the moment it was taken (a2, b1, no c); and the superseded first edition of a.codex must still be addressable by its hash, because a snapshot carries the history, not just the tree.
